slovak: Ona si kúpila nový kabát v zľave.
answer: Yesterday she bought a beautiful new winter coat on sale.

slovak: Pes zjedol moju večeru zo stola.
answer: The hungry dog quickly ate my whole dinner off the kitchen table.

slovak: Ona vyhodila staré noviny do koša.
answer: She angrily threw all the old newspapers into the bin in the kitchen.

slovak: Záhradník pokosil trávnik pred naším domom.
answer: This morning the gardener mowed the big lawn in front of our new house.

slovak: Robotníci budúci týždeň opravia cestu pred školou.
answer: The workers will quickly repair the whole road in front of the new school next week.

slovak: Otec minulý týždeň natrel plot na zeleno.
answer: Last week my dad carefully painted the whole new fence green.

slovak: Deti včera nakreslili veľký obrázok na chodník.
answer: The children drew a big picture on the pavement in front of the school yesterday.

slovak: Môj dedko pestuje paradajky v skleníku.
answer: My grandfather grows tomatoes and peppers in the greenhouse.

slovak: Ja teraz čítam novú knihu o zvieratách.
answer: I am reading an interesting new book about wild animals in my room now.
